title: HnRNP A2/B1 as a potential anti-tumor target for triptolide based on a simplified thermal proteome profiling method using XGBoost.
authors: Chen, Peng; Zhao, Pengcheng; Hu, Mingliang; Wang, Lili; Lei, Tong; Liu, Bin; Li, Li; Shi, Jianyu; Lu, Cheng
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文用XGBoost简化热蛋白质组方法筛选雷公藤甲素的蛋白靶点HnRNP A2/B1，虽涉及蛋白靶点与AI方法，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Triptolide (TP) is a highly active natural medicinal ingredient with significant potential in anticancer. The strong cytotoxicity of this compound suggests that it may have a wide range of targets within cells. However, further target screening is required at this stage. Traditional drug target screening methods can be significantly optimized using artificial intelligence (AI). PURPOSE:  This study aimed to identify the direct protein targets and explain the multitarget action mechanism of the anti-tumor effect of TP with the help of AI. METHODS:  The CCK8, scratch test, and flow cytometry analysis were used to examine cell proliferation, migration, cell cycle, and apoptosis in tumor cells treated with TP in vitro. The anti-tumor effect of TP in vivo was evaluated by constructing a tumor model in nude mice. Furthermore, we established a simplified thermal proteome analysis (TPP) method based on XGBoost (X-TPP) to rapidly screen the direct targets of TP. RESULTS: We validated the effects of TP on protein targets through RNA immunoprecipitation and pathways by qPCR and Western blotting. TP significantly inhibited tumor cell proliferation and migration and promoted apoptosis in vitro. Continuous administration of TP to tumor mice can significantly suppress tumor tissue size. We verified that TP can affect the thermal stability of HnRNP A2/B1 and exert anti-tumor effects by inhibiting HnRNP A2/B1-PI3K-AKT pathway. Adding siRNA to silence HnRNP A2/B1 also significantly down-regulated expression of AKT and PI3K. CONCLUSION: The X-TPP method was used to show that TP regulates tumor cell activity through its potential interaction with HnRNP A2/B1.
abstract_zh: 背景：雷公藤甲素（Triptolide, TP）是一种高活性天然药用成分，在抗癌方面具有显著潜力。该化合物的强细胞毒性表明其可能在细胞内具有广泛的靶点。然而，现阶段仍需进一步进行靶点筛选。传统药物靶点筛选方法可通过人工智能（AI）显著优化。目的：本研究旨在借助AI识别TP抗肿瘤作用的直接蛋白靶点，并解释其多靶点作用机制。方法：采用CCK8、划痕实验和流式细胞术分析检测TP处理的肿瘤细胞在体外的增殖、迁移、细胞周期和凋亡情况。通过构建裸鼠肿瘤模型评估TP在体内的抗肿瘤效果。此外，我们建立了一种基于XGBoost的简化热蛋白质组分析（X-TPP）方法，以快速筛选TP的直接靶点。结果：我们通过RNA免疫沉淀验证了TP对蛋白靶点的影响，并通过qPCR和Western blotting验证了相关通路。TP在体外显著抑制肿瘤细胞增殖和迁移，并促进凋亡。对肿瘤小鼠连续给药TP可显著抑制肿瘤组织大小。我们验证了TP可影响HnRNP A2/B1的热稳定性，并通过抑制HnRNP A2/B1-PI3K-AKT通路发挥抗肿瘤作用。添加siRNA沉默HnRNP A2/B1也显著下调了AKT和PI3K的表达。结论：使用X-TPP方法表明，TP通过其与HnRNP A2/B1的潜在相互作用调节肿瘤细胞活性。
